age_limit: As on the date of notification (28-08-2026): || Minimum age: 15 years completed || Maximum age: 22 years (Fresher/Ex-ITI) / 24 years (MLT) || Upper age relaxation: 3 years for OBC-(NCL), 5 years for SC/ST, 10 years for PwBD || Combined relaxation for PwBD candidates: UR/EWS + PwBD = 10 years; OBC-(NCL) + PwBD = 13 years; SC/ST + PwBD = 15 years || To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.
application_fee: Processing fee of Rs. 100/- (non-refundable), payable online. No fee is required for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates.
selection_process: Selection is based on a Merit List, prepared as follows: || Fresher Category: Matriculation marks converted to 200 (minimum 50% aggregate required, except SC/ST/PwBD). || Ex-ITI Category: Matriculation marks converted to 100 + ITI marks converted to 100 = 200 total, with equal weightage to both. || MLT Category: Higher Secondary marks (Physics, Chemistry, Maths & Biology) converted to 200. || In case of a tie, the older candidate is preferred; if birth dates are also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier is preferred.
